pk: nyayanrtatarangini ‘sarvasnin pratipanopaDO trEkalikaniseDapratiyogitvani’ti dvitiyapaksan dusayati – na dvitiya iti Otahaneriti upalaksananetat – tava nate rupyaniTyatvasya vyavahari-katvapakse tatvikatyantaBavapratiyogitvasya rupyeBavat saDyavEkalyan ca rupyaniTyatvasya tatvikatve tadboDakasya pratyaksadestatvavedakatvapatiriti ca boDyan nanu prapancaniseDaDikaraniButabrahnanatratvat prapancaniseDasya tatvikatvepi nadvEtahani-karatvaniti cet, nEvan; prapancaBranarTanaDisWanabrahnasPuranasyavasyakataya brahnaBinaprapanca-niseDasyapi prakase prapancaBranasanBavat na ca idantvaDisWanaprakasepi prapancaniseDatvadina na prakasa iti vacyan; tava nate prapancaniseDatvaderapi brahnanatratvat, anyaTa nirvisesatvaha-niprasangaditi sidDasaDanaditi atra saDyavEkalyanapi boDyan vyavaharikatve-piti Gawaditulyataya prapancaniseDasyapi baDyatvan; anyaTa drsyatvadestatrEva vyaBicara syadityarTa atra vadanti ‘atatvika eva niseDoyan atatvikatvepi na pratiBasika, kintu vyavaharika na ca tarhi niseDasya baDyatvena tatvikasatvaviroDitvadarTantaraniti vacyan; svapnarTasya svapnaniseDena baDadarsanat niseDasya baDyatvan paranarTikasatva-viroDitve na tantran, kintu niseDyapeksaya nyunasatakatvan, prakrte ca tulyasatakatvat kaTan na viroDitvan? ck: nyayanrtatarankini ‘sarvasnin pratipanopatO trEkalikanisetapratiyokitvani’ti tvitiyapaksan tusayati – na tvitiya iti Otahaneriti upalaksananetat – tava nate rupyanityatvasya vyavahari-katvapakse tatvikatyantapavapratiyokitvasya rupyepavat satyavEkalyan ca rupyanityatvasya tatvikatve tatpotakasya pratyaksatestatvavetakatvapatiriti ca potyan nanu prapancanisetatikaraniputaprahnanatratvat prapancanisetasya tatvikatvepi natvEtahani-karatvaniti cet, nEvan; prapancapranartanatistanaprahnaspuranasyavasyakataya prahnapinaprapanca-nisetasyapi prakase prapancapranasanpavat na ca itantvatistanaprakasepi prapancanisetatvatina na prakasa iti vacyan; tava nate prapancanisetatvaterapi prahnanatratvat, anyata nirvisesatvaha-niprasankatiti sitasatanatiti atra satyavEkalyanapi potyan vyavaharikatve-piti katatitulyataya prapancanisetasyapi patyatvan; anyata trsyatvatestatrEva vyapicara syatityarta atra vatanti ‘atatvika eva nisetoyan atatvikatvepi na pratipasika, kintu vyavaharika na ca tarhi nisetasya patyatvena tatvikasatvavirotitvatartantaraniti vacyan; svapnartasya svapnanisetena patatarsanat nisetasya patyatvan paranartikasatva-virotitve na tantran, kintu nisetyapeksaya nyunasatakatvan, prakrte ca tulyasatakatvat katan na virotitvan?
